evidence_quotes: I've been making this for years and it's wonderful BUT use equal amounts sweet green and red peppers - the colour of the jelly will be a wonderful amber hue.
Also, do use your food processor that's what those blades are for!

benefit.description: Using equal amounts of green and red peppers is expected to give the jelly the described amber hue; a food processor can finely chop the peppers.

edits.text: 1.5 cups finely chopped sweet red bell pepper

edits.replacement_text: Bring sugar, green and red bell peppers, and white vinegar to a boil in a large, stainless steel saucepan over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, 6 minutes.

edits.text: Finely chop the sweet green and red peppers in a food processor.

evidence_quotes: By the way, this jelly is a wonderful accompaniment for roast pork!

benefit.description: The reviewer describes the jelly as a wonderful accompaniment for roast pork.

edits.text: Serve the jelly with roast pork.
